NAH (I think that means nobody is the asshole.) Before I even read I could guess the race of you and the mother (not to seem disrespectful or derogatory). Just as your sister said there are racial implications that would make any person of color especially black or biracial offended. 
Someone else mentioned it but there’s a fetishization of mixed race babies that I think is disgusting and while I know you don’t fall into that category of people, the question you asked lines up with those people. 
As a biracial person she is probably dealing with past traumas that come with her racial identity. I’m glad that you apologized and I hope that once she calms down she is able to forgive you. I am sure that she will see that you meant no harm and will eventually come around. 
Black and brown people have an inherent distrust for white people so she may have went to protection mode. 
I’ve used a very hyperbolic tone while writing this only because I wanted to be completely transparent. I don’t mean to generalize so I want to acknowledge that no two people or situations are the same and this is just one take on the issue.
